anomalies.condition: An existing analyzer cannot be matched to exactly one Bridge profile revision
anomalies.action: Preserve the analyzer and copied configuration, leave the profile reference unresolved, and block activation

anomalies.condition: A legacy analyzer test code has no sourceRowKey in the selected profile revision
anomalies.action: Preserve the legacy row as unresolved migration evidence and do not infer a source row

anomalies.condition: Two source rows or aliases resolve to the same normalized code or local Test
anomalies.action: Preserve each source row independently and require an explicit binding for each row

anomalies.condition: A normalized code resolves to zero or multiple active local Tests
anomalies.action: Leave the site binding unresolved; automatic binding is allowed only for exactly one active Test

anomalies.condition: A legacy analyzer_test_map row points to an inactive or missing local Test
anomalies.action: Retain the source row and legacy target for audit, but do not create an active site binding

anomalies.condition: A qualitative_result_mapping stores free text without one active Result Option owned by the bound Test
anomalies.action: Classify the value as LEGACY_UNBOUND and require catalog-backed resolution

anomalies.condition: A candidate Result Option is inactive or belongs to a different local Test
anomalies.action: Reject the binding and keep the source value unresolved

anomalies.condition: A legacy ASTM, HL7, or direct import route receives traffic after the BR-M4 normalized-traffic cutover
anomalies.action: Reject the legacy write, retain diagnostics, and require Bridge-to-FHIR delivery

rollback.rule: Never reverse-transform target writes into legacy stores
